slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A ratio compares two quantities by division, a : b or a/b. A proportion says two ratios are equal: a/b = c/d.

Means-extremes property: if a/b = c/d (b and d not zero), then ad = bc.

A scale model at 1 : 200 that is 15 cm tall stands for a building 15 times 200 = 3,000 cm = 30 m tall. Solve x/12 = 5/8 by cross multiplying: 8x = 60, so x = 7.5.
